name: @superbee/browser-local
description: Browser-local working copy of a Superbee bundle: the IndexedDB bundle path proven in real Chromium, with the intent journal and sync verbs that relate it to a shared authority.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Publish only the reviewed browser-local tarball under the maintainer handoff in packages/browser-local/RELEASING.md; do not publish the workspace'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.test:browser: playwright install chromium && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.measure:browser: playwright install chromium && playwright test --config playwright.measure.config.ts measure.browser.spec.ts
scripts.measure:listing: playwright install chromium && playwright test --config playwright.measure.config.ts measure-listing.browser.spec.ts
